svg.aria-label: Token run on a BPMN diagram: Order payment (fixed) (TO-BE) - Order payment (fixed)

g.text: Scenario E · Payment gateway never replies

text.tspan: Token appears at start event “Customer taps Pay”.
Send message “Payment request” to Payment gateway.
Boundary “After 5 min” fires (solid border, interrupting): the task is cancelled and the token follows the exception
Ends at end event “Order awaiting reconciliation”.
